name: Electronic public procurement system (Montenegro)
notes: RI-TEC-038. Under implementation since January 2021 (World Bank slides); improvements in 2023-2024 and 2024-2025 and an EC-funded upgrade after the MAPS assessment. Items: MNE-IO-2023-001-0001, MNE-IO-2023-001-0006, MNE-IO-2023-001-0007, MNE-IO-2023-001-0008, MNE-EU-2024-001-0015, MNE-EU-2024-001-0017, MNE-EU-2024-001-0018, MNE-EU-2024-001-0019, MNE-EU-2025-001-0020. The red flag recommendations (MNE-EU-2025-001-0018, MNE-EU-2026-003-0002) and the 2026 'still awaiting' statement concern a function of this system. No source names the system; the upgrade may be recorded as an amends link if the lead agent prefers a separate record.

name: MAPS assessment with e-Procurement supplementary module (World Bank)
notes: RI-TEC-038. Requested by the Public Procurement Policy Unit of Montenegro; started January 2023; final delivery planned by January 2024 (slides); the 2024 Commission report says the MAPS project ended in December 2023. Items: MNE-IO-2023-001-0002 to MNE-IO-2023-001-0005, MNE-EU-2024-001-0016. Final report MNE-IO-2024-002 is inaccessible.

name: Law on compulsory health insurance (Montenegro)
notes: RI-FMW-015. Recognises the EHIC; the card is to be introduced only after accession (same wording in the 2024, 2025 and 2026 reports: MNE-EU-2024-001-0020, MNE-EU-2025-001-0021, MNE-EU-2026-003-0007). No adoption date stated.

name: Feasibility study on the introduction of the EHIC (Montenegro)
notes: RI-FMW-015. Requested by the 2025 report by end-2025 (MNE-EU-2025-001-0019, MNE-EU-2025-001-0022); 2026 report says it was updated with 2025 statistical data, found no significant financial obstacles and a basic legal and administrative framework in place, with technical and information capacities to be strengthened (MNE-EU-2026-003-0008 to MNE-EU-2026-003-0010). No date of the original study or update stated.

name: Action Plan for the Coordination of Social Security Systems 2026-2028 (Montenegro)
notes: RI-FMW-015 (also relevant to RI-FMW-010, EESSI). Adopted by the government in February 2026 (MNE-EU-2026-003-0006); integrates the EHIC feasibility study findings and outlines the technical and IT upgrades required before accession (MNE-EU-2026-003-0011).

name: Integrated Health Information System (Montenegro)
notes: RI-FMW-015. Existing system; the 2026 key recommendation asks to improve it and adapt it for issuing and applying the EHIC by accession. Named only in the recommendation.
